rows.ja: 大株主・事業の売却先
予約システム(GDS)の利用企業

companies.name: コンステレーション・ソフトウェア
companies.sub: 業種特化ソフトの買収・運営

relations.text: 2026年3月、Sabreと戦略的ガバナンス契約を結び、取締役を1名送り込む
relations.text_en: Signed a strategic governance agreement with Sabre in March 2026 and placed a representative on its board

source.label: Sabre・Constellation Software 共同発表(8-K添付)
source.label_en: Sabre and Constellation Software joint release (8-K exhibit)
source.quote: Sabre and Constellation Software Enter into Strategic Governance Agreement Sabre Appoints Damian McKay to Board of Directors as a Representative of Constellation

relations.text: 2025年7月、Sabreのホテル向けソフト事業(Hospitality Solutions)をTPGの関連会社が買収
relations.text_en: A TPG affiliate bought Sabre's Hospitality Solutions business, closing in July 2025

source.label: Sabre 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we entered into a definitive purchase agreement with an affiliate of TPG (the "Buyer"), an unrelated party, pursuant to which the Buyer agreed to purchase our Hospitality Solutions business, and on July 3, 2025, we closed the sale

relations.text: SabreのGDSを利用し、Sabreが奨励金を払う契約(CWTはSabre製品も購入)
relations.text_en: Uses Sabre's GDS under an agreement where Sabre pays incentive fees and CWT buys Sabre products

source.label: Sabre 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Sabre has an agreement with CWT pursuant to which Sabre provides CWT with access to its GDS and pays incentive fees to CWT, and CWT purchases certain products from Sabre.

relations.text: 航空券などの在庫確保のため、GDSとしてAmadeusとSabreを使う
relations.text_en: Uses Amadeus and Sabre as its GDS providers for travel content

source.label: Expedia 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We use Amadeus and Sabre as our GDS segment providers in order to ensure the widest possible supply of content for our travelers.

relations.text: 運賃などをSabreなどのアグリゲーター経由で第三者に配信
relations.text_en: Distributes its content to third parties through aggregators including Sabre

source.label: American Airlines 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we distribute our content to third parties through aggregators (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport and Travelfusion) or through direct connections.

relations.text: 法人出張向けに、Sabreなど主要GDSで運賃を予約できるようにしている
relations.text_en: Lets corporate travelers book its fares through major GDSs including Sabre

source.label: Southwest Airlines 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: book Southwest fares within all major Global Distribution System platforms via Amadeus, Travelport, and Sabre channels

relations.text: Amadeus・Sabre・Travelportと長年の契約を持つ
relations.text_en: Has long-standing agreements with the GDSs Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport

source.label: Ryanair 20-F(2026年度)
source.quote: The Company has long-standing agreements with the GDSs Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport.

relations.text: 販売費の一部としてSabreなどGDSへの支払いがある
relations.text_en: Pays global distribution systems such as Sabre as part of its sales costs

source.label: Copa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: payments to global distribution systems "GDS", such as Amadeus and Sabre.

relations.text: Sabreなどからソフトウェアのライセンスを受けて運用
relations.text_en: Runs software licensed from vendors including Sabre

source.label: Azul 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We operate software products under licenses from our vendors, including Oracle, Trax, Sabre, Navitaire, Amadeus

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
